how we work in noida.

We take on residential and commercial projects in Noida and Greater Noida, coordinated from our studio and site office in Narela, Delhi.

High-rise apartments are where most Noida projects start: a fixed footprint, builder-standard finishes and a family that wants storage, better kitchens and lighting that works. We plan from the layout first, draw every joinery piece, and price from an itemised BOQ.

To be clear about our proof: we do not yet have a published Noida case study. The projects below are from Delhi and Gurgaon and show the same team’s apartment, kitchen and office work.

practical guidance

planning an apartment interior in noida

Check the society rules first

If your society has rules on working hours, material movement or deposits, share them early so the site plan accounts for them.

Decide what stays

Builder-supplied flooring, kitchens and wardrobes are sometimes worth keeping. We review them with you before designing around or replacing them.

Fix the budget before finishes

We agree a budget range at the alignment stage and develop an itemised BOQ, so material choices are made against real numbers.

noida — faqs

questions, answered.

Does Indéva Studio work in Noida and Greater Noida?

Yes. We take on residential and commercial projects in Noida and Greater Noida, coordinated from our studio and site office in Narela, Delhi.

Do you have completed projects in Noida on your website?

Not yet. Our published case studies are from Delhi, Gurgaon and Murthal. We are happy to talk through relevant work from those projects at the first meeting.

Do you provide design and execution in Noida?

Yes — either design only or design with execution, agreed in writing at onboarding.

How much does interior design cost in Noida?

It depends on area, scope and finish level. We discuss budget openly before design starts and prepare an itemised BOQ rather than quoting a flat rate.

What information do you need for an initial estimate?

Property type, approximate area, rooms or spaces in scope, expected start date and a budget range if you have one. A floor plan helps.
